What does carpet installation cost on Mercer Island, WA?

Plan on $4 to $7 per square foot installed, covering carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away. Most Mercer Island projects total between $2,000 and $4,500, and a 1,200 sq ft main level with a staircase generally runs $5,500 to $8,500. Carpet grade moves the number more than anything else, and you choose yours from full-size samples lying on your own floor.
Does the mobile carpet showroom really come to Mercer Island?

It does — the van makes the bridge crossing constantly. It arrives with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades, and every option gets laid in the room it's meant for, so fir shade and lake light get a vote. Then we measure each level and stair and hand over an itemized written price the same visit. The appointment costs nothing.
What does carpet stretching cost on Mercer Island?

Stretching starts at $99 per room. A power stretcher pulls the ripples, waves and lifted edges flat again for roughly a fifth of what replacement runs, so it's the right call whenever the pile still stands up and the color still suits the room it lives in.
What do carpeted stairs cost on Mercer Island?

Stair carpet starts at $18 per step, installed waterfall or cap-and-band. Mercer Island tri-levels and split entries are full of landings and pie-shaped winders, and every one of them is counted in the written quote up front — none of them shows up later as an extra charge.
How long does a Mercer Island carpet installation take?

One day covers most Island homes. Three or four rooms plus a staircase fits comfortably between a morning start and dinner, while a whole multi-level house with heavy furniture can carry into a second day. The timeline is written on your quote, so you can plan the week around it.
Will the installers move my furniture?

Yes. On most jobs the crew moves beds, couches, dressers and tables, then sets everything back where it lived — it's part of the job, not an add-on. We ask you to handle the light stuff: closet floors, electronics, plants and anything breakable you'd rather carry yourself.
Is it better to stretch my carpet or replace it?

Stretch when the pile stands tall, the backing holds together and the color still earns its keep — a $99-per-room fix beats buying a houseful of carpet. Replace when traffic paths are matted flat, seams are pulling apart, the backing is crumbling, or pet odor has survived a professional cleaning. We inspect first and tell you which situation you have before any quote.
Which Mercer Island neighborhoods do you cover?

Every corner of the Island — Town Center, First Hill, East Seattle, Roanoke, Mercerdale, Mercerwood, Barnabie Point, Faben Point, Proctor Landing and The Lakes, from the north end to the south end — plus Enatai, Beaux Arts Village, Newport Shores and Seattle just across the bridges.
What carpet holds up best with pets?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing over a moisture-barrier pad. The barrier stops accidents from reaching the subfloor — the source of odor that never leaves — and solution-dyed fiber can take diluted bleach without losing its color. The barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot, and it rides along with the rest of the samples.
What kind of warranty backs the work?

Every install carries OC Flooring's 1-year workmanship warranty, and the carpet itself carries its mill warranty — typically 10 to 25 years on wear and stain depending on grade. Both are spelled out on your written quote. Because pad choice can affect mill coverage, all three pad grades come to the measure so you pick with the fine print in view.
